sentence_stem: Although the new law was passed last year,
correct_completion: many citizens still do not know their rights.
full_sentence: Although the new law was passed last year, many citizens still do not know their rights.
acceptable_variants: most people are still unaware of it.
the public has little information about it.

options.text: so the government changed its budget.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but the sentence needs a contrast after 'although'.

options.text: many citizens still do not know their rights.
the newspaper reported it in detail.
options.why_wrong: This adds a fact about the newspaper but does not contrast with the law being passed.
This is unrelated to the law and does not show the contrast expected after 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the second part of the sentence must contrast with the first part. Here the passing of a law is contrasted with citizens not knowing their rights.
